sunspot_dataset_pin.series: SILSO monthly mean total sunspot number, version 2.0

santa_fe_dataset_pin.series: Santa Fe Time Series Competition Series A far-infrared laser intensity

tuning_budget.split: all valid divisor k values (8, 6, or 4 by setting) crossed with the shared 7-value lambda grid
tuning_budget.covariance_ev: 8 preregistered alpha values crossed with the shared 7-value lambda grid; never fewer outer candidates than Split
tuning_budget.comparison_contract: identical chronological folds, identical lambda grid, and identical one-time held-out test access
tuning_budget.k_grid_rule: all divisors of N, including endpoints k=1 and k=N
tuning_budget.fixed_baselines: the shared 7-value lambda grid; no artificial second hyperparameter

registered_objectives.ridge: mean squared loss over training rows + lambda * ||w||_2^2
registered_objectives.covariance_ev: mean squared loss over time + alpha * w^T Sigma_shot w + lambda * ||w||_2^2
registered_objectives.implementation_note: sklearn Ridge receives alpha=lambda*n_training_rows so lambda has the same meaning for every group count

partition_robustness.note: Twenty per-time partitions plus the fixed-lane comparison; analyzed separately from headline rows.

normalization.train_fitted_affine_scale: min-max from the earliest training prefix
normalization.targets: same train-fitted affine scale, never clipped; values outside [0,1] are retained

partitioning.operation: for each k, independently permute raw shot indices at every time step, form contiguous group means, then apply the linear leak and ten-lag map to each grouped sequence
partitioning.split_groups: contiguous blocks after the k-specific permutation
partitioning.candidate_k: all divisors of N, including k=1 and k=N as safe fallbacks; interior selections are reported separately

split_vs_covariance_ev.interpretation: direct covariance regularization is not substantially better than Split

notes: Reservoir seed 1729 is fixed and published; two additional fixed seeds measure sensitivity.
The primary representation contains all local Z features and neighboring ZZ features from the same shots.
Santa Fe uses five fully disjoint 1001-sample windows from the 9093-point continuation.
Shot, reservoir, and partition seeds are nested factors, never treated as independent inferential clusters.
The final test block is evaluated once after validation selects all applicable hyperparameters.
